payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP over boards with state (index, current_increase) where increase is 0,1,2 to ensure adjacent heights differ; transition checks previous increase.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a 2D DP table dp[i][j] where i is board index and j ∈ {0,1,2} is the increment. Despite small constant second dimension, the state is fundamentally two-dimensional.
